thread:
alex.w: Quick ask — I'm testing a new private VPC endpoint for partner-ingest. Need to validate outbound egress rules and flow log redaction before we run load tests. Can someone confirm: 1) allowed outbound IPs for the endpoint (we plan to hit 35.209.45.12), 2) whether VPC flow logs or S3 access logs leak object keys, and 3) who can approve temporary SG opening for ~2hrs? TL;DR: need temp egress to 35.209.45.12:443 and guidance on flow log masking. @kate @samir

kate: Quick answers — we only need to add an outbound rule on the private-ingest SG (no NACL changes). Use 35.209.45.12/32 (specify single IP). For short tests tag the rule with `temp-test-1955551234` and a ticket link. VPC Flow Logs do NOT contain S3 object keys (they're network-level). S3 access logs contain object keys unless you enable server-side redaction in our pipeline. See internal doc: https://go/repo/security/flowlogs-redaction (short summary in ticket).

samir: Confirming Kate. VPC flow logs = 5-tuple + bytes/packets, no object keys. If you need to avoid S3 object key capture, we have two standard options: 1) presigned URLs (no key in logs), or 2) enable s3-log-redaction pipeline (adds key-hash). For approvals: security-approvals@redwood.com or any on-call sec approver. I can approve a 2h exception if you include justification + rollback steps here.

alex.w: Thanks — justification: running partner ingest load test (validate latency/kv-cache behavior). Impact: outbound only to partner IP, no inbound changes. Rollback: infra will remove rule after test, and I'll confirm. I'll open ticket with runbook and link back here.

maria: I can approve. Please include last 4 of requestor's commit hash and exact start/end times in the ticket. Approving for 2 hours from start time. @infra-bot please schedule removal.

infra-bot: Action queued: CHG-9812 created by alex.w for sg `sg-private-ingest` — add outbound TCP 443 to 35.209.45.12/32, tag `temp-test-1955551234`, auto-remove after 2h. Minimal IAM used: infra-temp-runner role. ETA ~6m to apply.

alex.w: Awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll kick off the tests once infra-bot posts completion and will paste results + logs to the ticket.

kate: One more note — add label `sensitive=ingest` to the flow log group while tests run. That ensures downstream reducers apply key-hash if we accidentally capture higher-level metadata.

infra-bot: CHG-9812 applied at 1955551240. Removal scheduled for 1955552440 (2h).

alex.w: Verified rule applied and tests started. Will report back with perf numbers and any log snippets (redacted).
